# CommandBarFlyout

Header: `winui/ui/menus/CommandBarFlyout.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/menus/CommandBarFlyout.hpp`.

The mini-toolbar of an in-app object: a small row of icon-only commands in a flyout, with a menu of more commands under it behind a "More" button.

Like every [FlyoutBase](flyout.md#class-flyoutbase), it sits in the tree wrapping its anchor ([set_anchor()](flyout.md#set_anchor)) and shows its content as a popup. Primary commands (app-bar buttons) form a row of 40x40 icon buttons, and secondary commands form the menu. The show mode decides how it opens. Transient, for a click, starts with the menu collapsed and takes no focus. Standard, for a context menu, starts expanded and focuses the first command. Clicking a secondary command closes the flyout, and clicking a primary one collapses the menu. The menu always opens downward, and primary commands never move into it.

Example: 
```cpp
auto flyout = std::make_unique<ui::CommandBarFlyoutControl>();
flyout->set_placement(ui::PopupPlacement::Right);
flyout->set_show_mode(ui::FlyoutShowMode::Transient);
flyout->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Share", ui::Symbol::Share));
flyout->add_primary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Delete", ui::Symbol::Delete));
auto* resize = flyout->add_secondary(std::make_unique<ui::AppBarButtonControl>("Resize"));
resize->on_click([] { /* resize the photo */ });
flyout->set_anchor(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Photo")); // a Button anchor toggles it
window.set_content(std::move(flyout));

// Declaratively; open it through `.control`:
ui::Control<ui::CommandBarFlyout> photo_menu;
window.set_content(ui::CommandBarFlyout{
    .placement = ui::PopupPlacement::Right,
    .show_mode = ui::FlyoutShowMode::Transient,
    .control   = photo_menu,
    .anchor    = ui::Button{.text = "Photo", .on_click = [&] { photo_menu->show(); }},
    .primary   = {ui::AppBarButton{.text = "Share", .icon = ui::Symbol::Share},
                  ui::AppBarButton{.text = "Delete", .icon = ui::Symbol::Delete}},
    .secondary = {ui::AppBarButton{.text = "Resize"}},
});
```

## `ui::CommandBarFlyout`

A small bar of commands in a flyout, with a menu of more under it. Builds a [ui::CommandBarFlyoutControl](#uicommandbarflyoutcontrol). To open it, call `show()` on its [`.control`](#uicommandbarflyout-control) handle from the anchor's handlers. Use [`show_mode`](#uicommandbarflyout-show_mode) Transient for a click and Standard for a context menu.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Control<ui::CommandBarFlyout> flyout;

window.set_content(ui::CommandBarFlyout{
    .placement = ui::PopupPlacement::Right,
    .show_mode = ui::FlyoutShowMode::Transient,
    .control   = flyout,
    .anchor    = ui::Button{ .text = "Photo", .on_click = [&] { flyout->show(); } },
    .primary   = { ui::AppBarButton{ .text = "Share", .icon = ui::Symbol::Share },
                   ui::AppBarButton{ .text = "Save", .icon = ui::Symbol::Save },
                   ui::AppBarButton{ .text = "Delete", .icon = ui::Symbol::Delete } },
    .secondary = { ui::AppBarButton{ .text = "Resize" } },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::CommandBarFlyout{
    .is_open, .placement, .placement_alignment, .always_expanded, .show_mode, .light_dismiss,
    .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height,
    .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .accessibility,
    .on_opened, .on_closing, .on_closed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited,
    .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .anchor, .primary,
    .secondary
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Two-way with [ui::bind()](../core/namespace-ui.md#bind): closing it writes false, and a false that [`on_closing`](#uicommandbarflyout-on_closing) cancels is put back to true. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-placement"></span>`placement` | `ui::Binding<ui::PopupPlacement>` | `{ui::PopupPlacement::Above}` | Which side of the anchor it opens on. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-placement_alignment"></span>`placement_alignment` | `ui::Binding<ui::PopupPlacementAlignment>` | `{ui::PopupPlacementAlignment::Center}` | How the flyout lines up with the anchor along that side. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-always_expanded"></span>`always_expanded` | `ui::Binding<bool>` | `{false}` | The secondary menu shows whenever the flyout does. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-show_mode"></span>`show_mode` | `ui::Binding<ui::FlyoutShowMode>` | `{ui::FlyoutShowMode::Standard}` | Transient, for a click, opens with the menu collapsed and leaves focus alone. Standard, for a context menu, opens it expanded and takes focus. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-light_dismiss"></span>`light_dismiss` | `ui::Binding<bool>` | `{true}` | Whether an outside click or Escape closes it; true by default. Off, it stays open until [`is_open`](#uicommandbarflyout-is_open) turns false, hide() runs or a command in it runs. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_opened"></span>`on_opened` | `ui::Action` |  | The flyout is showing. A two-way [`is_open`](#uicommandbarflyout-is_open) has been written by then. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_closing"></span>`on_closing` | `ui::Callback<ui::Decision(const ui::PopupClosingArgs&)>` |  | Gets why it is about to close; return [ui::Cancel](../core/namespace-ui.md#cancel) to keep it open. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_closed"></span>`on_closed` | `ui::Callback<void(ui::PopupCloseReason)>` |  | Gets why it closed, once the close fade has finished. A two-way [`is_open`](#uicommandbarflyout-is_open) has been written by then. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::CommandBarFlyout>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control, through which to show() it. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-anchor"></span>`anchor` | `ui::Spec` |  | The in-tree element the flyout hangs from. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-primary"></span>`primary` | `ui::SpecList` |  | The icon row, as app-bar specs. |
| <span id="uicommandbarflyout-secondary"></span>`secondary` | `ui::SpecList` |  | The menu under the row, as app-bar specs. |

### CommandBarFlyoutControl

```cpp
CommandBarFlyoutControl()
```

An empty flyout with no anchor.

### ~CommandBarFlyoutControl

```cpp
~CommandBarFlyoutControl() override
```

Destroys every command and the presenter.

### add_primary

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add_primary(std::unique_ptr<T> command)
```

Appends `command` to the icon row. Takes ownership and hands back a non-owning observer (the same convention as [StackControl::add()](../layout/stack.md#add)).

### add_secondary

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add_secondary(std::unique_ptr<T> command)
```

Appends `command` to the menu. Takes ownership and hands back a non-owning observer.

### primary_count

```cpp
std::size_t primary_count() const
```

The number of primary commands.

### secondary_count

```cpp
std::size_t secondary_count() const
```

The number of secondary commands.

### primary

```cpp
Element* primary(std::size_t index) const
```

The primary command at `index` as a non-owning observer, or nullptr when out of range.

### secondary

```cpp
Element* secondary(std::size_t index) const
```

The secondary command at `index` as a non-owning observer, or nullptr when out of range.

### always_expanded

```cpp
bool always_expanded() const
```

Whether the menu of secondary commands stays open, with no More button. False by default.

### set_always_expanded

```cpp
void set_always_expanded(bool always_expanded)
```

Takes effect the next time the flyout opens.

### is_expanded

```cpp
bool is_expanded() const
```

Whether the secondary menu shows. Every open resets it from the show mode: expanded for Standard when there are secondary commands, collapsed for Transient.

### set_expanded

```cpp
void set_expanded(bool expanded)
```

Expands or collapses the menu with a slide, as the More button does. Ignored while [always_expanded()](#always_expanded), so the menu stays expanded.

### command_invoked

```cpp
void command_invoked(CommandBarElement& command) override
```

Called when a command is clicked. A secondary command hides the flyout, and a primary one collapses the menu.

### handle_global_shortcut

```cpp
bool handle_global_shortcut(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

The shortcuts of the secondary commands and of the anchor fire app-wide.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Runs the open/close fade and the menu's slide.
